Design.description: Top-level InfraSim design document stored as JSON.

NodeInstance.description: Service node placed on the canvas.

NodeConfig.description: Editable behavioral, capacity, mock, and pricing configuration for a node.

RuntimePreset.description: Runtime concurrency preset for compute nodes.

AutoscalingConfig.description: Autoscaling rule configuration for compute/container/database nodes.

LatencyModel.description: Latency sampling parameters anchored at p50 and p95 in milliseconds.

HealthCheck.description: Load balancer target health check configuration.

OperationOverride.description: Override parameters for a single operation on a node.

ScenarioOverride.description: Time-boxed scenario override applied to a node during a simulation window.

EdgeInstance.description: Directed connection between two nodes on the canvas.

GroupInstance.description: Hierarchical container group (Region, VPC, Subnet, AZ, Cluster, Compartment).

NetworkConfig.description: Network topology and security configuration attached to a Design.

RouteTarget.description: Destination target of a route entry.

FirewallObject.description: Security group, NACL, NSG, GCP firewall, or OCI security list.

FirewallRule.description: Single ingress or egress rule within a firewall object.

Selector.description: Traffic source or destination selector in a firewall rule.

Peering.description: Peering link between two virtual networks.

DnsZone.description: Public or private DNS zone visible to attached networks.

PrivateEndpoint.description: Private endpoint / PrivateLink / PSC / OCI Service Gateway binding.

Attachment.description: Network attachment binding a node to a subnet, IPs, firewalls, and tags.

Scenario.description: Load test scenario combining traffic shape, user flows, and chaos events.

TrafficProfile.description: Arrival rate curve over scenario duration.

UserFlow.description: Weighted user journey executed by simulated clients.

ChaosEvent.description: Fault or degradation injection event active between atS and atS + durationS.

ScriptAsset.description: User-authored JS or TS handler or k6-style traffic script.

PayloadFixture.description: Test payload fixture passed to user handler code in dry-runs and profiling.

FixtureTemplateId.description: Known event template identifiers for the payload fixture library.

DesignSettings.description: Global simulation and pricing preferences for a design.

CustomServiceDefinition.description: User-created custom service definition embedded in a design or saved per user.

MockKind.description: Behavioral kind determining how the simulation engine handles a service node.

CapacitySpec.description: Capacity behavior specification for a service catalog entry.

ErrorKindDef.description: Error specification defined on a service or operation.

QuotaSpec.description: Quota specification listed in a catalog service entry.

OperationDef.description: Operation supported by a service definition.

PriceModel.description: Pricing dimension model code used by catalog tables and cost engine.

CustomPreset.description: Saved per-node Latency & Mock preset created by the user.
